# Rishi Kulshreshtha

> Senior Drupal engineer focused on web accessibility (WCAG, Section 508, ADA) and AI-readiness of public-interest websites — higher education, research, and government. Maintainer of LLMs.txt Gen and other open-source Drupal modules. Building with Drupal since 2011.

## About

Rishi Kulshreshtha is a senior Drupal engineer at Redfin Solutions, LLC, based in Maine. He focuses on making public-interest websites — for universities, research institutions, and government agencies — both accessible to people and legible to AI systems.

- Building with Drupal since 2011
- Web accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA, Section 508, ADA compliance
- AI-readiness: llms.txt, AI-ready content, LLM integration with CMS platforms
- Open-source contributor on Drupal.org and GitHub
- Based in Maine, USA

## Skills

Core: Drupal (6–11), PHP, JavaScript, Svelte, Python
Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA, Section 508, ADA, accessible front-end implementation
AI/ML: LLM integration, prompt engineering, AI-ready content, llms.txt
DevOps: GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Linux, Docker
Other: REST/GraphQL APIs, SEO

## Open Source Projects

Active contributor to the Drupal project — modules, patches, and issue queue participation on drupal.org/u/rishikulshreshtha.

- LLMs.txt Gen — a Drupal module that generates llms.txt so AI agents can read a site accurately: https://www.drupal.org/project/llms_txt_gen
- Hover Card — Drupal module: https://www.drupal.org/project/hover_card
- SiteInfo — Drupal module: https://www.drupal.org/project/siteinfo

## Playground

A separate, clearly-marked page of small arcade games (Memory Match, Sliding Puzzle, Whack-a-Bug, Bug Runner, Asteroid Dodge) built to test Svelte 5, Canvas, and Web Audio. They're a curiosity, not required reading, and are disclosed as not screen-reader accessible — see /accessibility-statement.
